example.title: Oceanfront resort hotel tower on Pacific Coast Highway (Waterfront Beach Resort)

brief: A 1990 oceanfront resort hotel tower: an eight-storey white stucco slab with continuous balconies with white rails on every floor across the sea front, a red-tile hip roof over a taller central bay topped by an arched belvedere, Mediterranean detailing, facing the beach across Pacific Coast Highway. One photo (during an air show). Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).
